payload.title: notifications settings tab opens
payload.errorMessage:
Timed out 5000ms waiting for expect(locator).toBeVisible()

Locator: getByRole('tab', { name: 'Notifications' })
Expected: visible
Received: <element(s) not found>

note: Both attempts fail identically on 'element(s) not found', not an intermittent visibility toggle, and neither attempt diverges from the other the way this dataset's flaky-as-real-bug cases do. Settings recently moved from a tab strip to a collapsible accordion, so a role of 'tab' no longer exists on that page at all; there is no timing element to be flaky about. This is distinguished from a true flake by the failure being structural (the element's role was removed) rather than transient.
